name: c10_terrain_orders
purpose: Psychic Terrain's TryHit handler (priority 4) comes before Protect's (3): Basculegion's Aqua Jet at a protecting Ceruledge gets Psychic Terrain's line. Raichu's Fake Out at its own protecting ally is not stopped by the terrain, so Protect's line comes. Raichu's Grassy Seed waits under Psychic Terrain; Rillaboom's Grassy Surge replaces the terrain without an end line, the seed acts, and Aqua Jet hits again.
